title: Your Vegas, slowed down

chapters.title: A slower morning
chapters.text: Heated basalt and quiet cedar aromas allowed the hurry of previous weeks to softly dissolve.

chapters.title: Sunlit brunch
chapters.text: Chilled champagne and warm brioche framed a relaxed afternoon with nowhere else you needed to be.

chapters.title: The golden hour
chapters.text: From high above the boulevard, desert amber settled into twilight as glasses were raised.

chapters.title: An intimate dinner
chapters.text: The scent of charred oak and vintage cabernet turned the evening into an unhurried feast.

chapters.title: Shared evening rhythms
chapters.text: Warm brass melodies filled the room as you shared tableside cocktails with fellow guests under soft amber light.

closingLine: When you are ready to pause again, your sanctuary will be waiting.
